name: Viva Biotech Holdings
summary: Viva Biotech Holdings is a Shanghai-based investment holding company, founded in 2008, offering structure-based drug discovery services to biotech and pharmaceutical clients around the world. Its services include protein expression, structural biology, hit identification, medicinal and synthetic chemistry and computer-aided drug design. It also performs antibody drug research, supplies biological resources such as cell lines and crystal structures, and provides contract development and manufacturing.
